description: 11e Tactical, human player: Engage on All Fronts is MET (3 units wholly in 3 quarters, >6" from centre), so the Scoring phase offers it as Score-or-Hold. The AI suggestion must say End Turn scores it (secondary_score record, 'MET' note) instead of only weighing a discard. Also: the quarter heuristic no longer counts a unit straddling the halfway line.

steps.equals: END_SCORING|End Turn — scores Engage on All Fronts 3 VP|true

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("Score 'Engage on All Fronts' now (3 VP)") and main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("is MET")
